title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:ru-with-a-clock
canDo: I can write lines I own to a named reader inside a three-minute practice clock, and say why, under this book's 66%-everywhere target, the weakest TORFL subtest decides.

payoff.summary: Complete RU-W259-with-a-clock: ten minutes on the book's clock, stop on time, then check the handwritten shapes before counting anything.
payoff.note: The exam facts are those assessment-spec.md records from the Pushkin Institute: TORFL Elementary Level (ТЭУ/A1) is five separate subtests, about 3 h 30 min in all, and this book targets 66% on every one of them. The writing paper's own minutes and length are deliberately not quoted: russian/task-shapes/a1.json has not been transcribed, so the three-minute clock is the book's, not the exam's, and it keeps the lesson inside the five-minute cap.
